-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvNodeCtx` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem isContext_Err_done [package_sem : Assumptions] (hED : context.ErrDone.spec) (ctx :
    GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, isPkgInit pkg_id.context ∗
    context.isContext ctx cd ∗ □ cd.PDone ∗ context.ContextClosed cd.Done_gn -∗ (▷ ∀ err, ctxErr cd
    err -∗ Φ (intoVal err)) -∗ WP ((intoVal (methods ctx.ty go!"Err" ctx.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}

theorem nodeDone_recv_clause [package_sem : Assumptions] (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd :
    context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (ch : GoChan) (body : Expr) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : ⊢ nodeDone
    ctx cd ch -∗ (context.isContext ctx cd ∗ □ cd.PDone ∗ context.ContextClosed cd.Done_gn -∗ WP
    (body (intoVal (), intoVal false)) {{ Φ }}) -∗ chan.blockingClausePre (CommClause (RecvCase
    (go.StructType []) (intoVal ch)) body) Φ ∨ chan.nilClausePre (CommClause (RecvCase
    (go.StructType []) (intoVal ch)) body)

theorem propErr_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : ⊢ propErr cd
    GoInterface.nil

def nodeDone (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (ch : GoChan) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜ch = chan.nil⌝ ∨ (∃ γch, context.isContextDone cd ch γch) ∗ context.isContext ctx cd)

theorem nodeCtx_background [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : ⊢
    nodeCtx context.backgroundCtxVal cd

theorem waitErr_ctx [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err :
    GoInterface) (wait : Bool) : ctxErr cd err ⊢ if wait = true then propErr cd err else nodeErr cd
    err

theorem nodeDone_persistent (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (ch :
    GoChan) : Persistent (nodeDone ctx cd ch)

theorem propErr_of_stepErr [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err :
    GoInterface) : stepErr err ⊢ propErr cd err

theorem propErr_of_nodeErr [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err :
    GoInterface) : nodeErr cd err ⊢ propErr cd err

theorem nodeErr_stopped [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err :
    GoInterface) : errStopped err ⊢ nodeErr cd err

theorem nodeCtx_Done [package_sem : Assumptions] (ctx : GoInterfaceOk) (cd : context.ContextDesc
    (IProp GF)) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, nodeCtx ctx cd -∗ (▷ ∀ ch, nodeDone ctx cd ch -∗ Φ (intoVal ch)) -∗ WP
    ((intoVal (methods ctx.ty go!"Done" ctx.v)) (intoVal ())) {{ Φ }}

theorem nodeErr_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) : ⊢ nodeErr cd
    GoInterface.nil

theorem doneNilCtx_background [package_sem : Assumptions] : ⊢ doneNilCtx context.backgroundCtxVal

theorem waitErr_stopped [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err :
    GoInterface) (wait : Bool) : errStopped err ⊢ if wait = true then propErr cd err else nodeErr cd
    err

theorem nodeErr_ctx [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (err :
    GoInterface) : ctxErr cd err ⊢ nodeErr cd err

theorem ctxErrVal_ne_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (err : GoInterface) : ctxErrVal err ⊢ ⌜err ≠
    GoInterface.nil⌝

theorem waitErr_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (cd : context.ContextDesc (IProp GF)) (wait : Bool)
    : ⊢ if wait = true then propErr cd GoInterface.nil else nodeErr cd GoInterface.nil
